pdf.js 6.3.289 (Apache-2.0) — lay tu npm `pdfjs-dist`, chep vao day de extension
chay hoan toan offline, khong goi CDN.

  pdf.mjs            thu vien chinh
  pdf.worker.mjs     worker phan tich PDF
  textlayer.css      trich tu pdf_viewer.css, chi phan .textLayer
                     (lop chu trong suot phu len canvas — nho no moi boi den duoc)
  standard_fonts/    font Type1 chuan (Helvetica, Times...)
  cmaps/             bang ma cho PDF tieng Trung/Nhat/Han
  wasm/              giai ma anh JPEG2000 trong PDF quet
